name: Bubble Menu
description: Floating pill-shaped header with a logo bubble and a hamburger toggle that opens a full-screen overlay of rounded link pills popping in with staggered scale and label animations.
contents: Logo bubble (image URL or custom node)
Hamburger toggle bubble that morphs into an X
Overlay with a grid of rounded link pills, each with a label and its own hover color
behavior: Pills scale in with a staggered, slightly randomized delay and labels slide up and fade in
Closing scales pills out quickly and unmounts the overlay
On screens 900px and wider pills are tilted by each item's rotation and scale on hover with the item's hover colors
Below 900px pills stack in a single full-width column with no rotation
Resize while open re-applies or removes pill rotation

props.name: items
props.default: 5 sample items: home, about, projects, blog, contact

editableByProps: Logo, menu links, labels, hrefs, aria labels, tilt angles and per-item hover colors
Bubble and pill background and content colors
Fixed or absolute positioning, extra class and style
Open animation ease, duration and stagger

needsCodeEdit.where: min-width 899px/900px media queries in the style tag and handleResize

needsCodeEdit.change: Change close animation speed or easing
needsCodeEdit.where: The else if (showOverlay) branch of the first useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pill size and layout columns
needsCodeEdit.where: pill-col flex-basis class and pill-link style (minHeight, padding, fontSize)

fixed: Requires Tailwind CSS classes and gsap
Injects a style tag with global .bubble-menu and .bubble-menu-items rules
Header sits at top-8 with z-index 1001 and overlay at 1000
Overlay is only mounted while open or closing
Pills are laid out three per row on desktop, with fourth item centered when 4 or 5 items
Pill rotation only applies at 900px and wider
Logo bubble and pills use white fallback background and fixed shadows
Random jitter of 0.05s added to each pill's stagger delay
